inputs.text:
TASK: Colorize the first manga page using only the source image and conservative anime color reasoning.

PRIORITY ORDER: 1) immutable source geometry and text, 2) linework and luminance structure, 3) consistent colors for repeated visible regions on this page, 4) complete background and object colorization. If instructions conflict, follow the higher priority.

SOURCE AUTHORITY: The first input image is the sole authority for canvas, crop, panel layout, composition, perspective, anatomy, pose, facial features, hairstyle shape, clothing structure, props, architecture, terrain, effects, linework, screentones, hatching, and existing light-and-shadow boundaries. Preserve every existing region, contour, fold, expression, object, and empty area in the same position, size, and shape. Never add, remove, complete, repair, simplify, or redesign content.

TEXT AND GRAPHICS LOCK: Speech bubbles, caption boxes, narration boxes, signs, labels, logos, and sound-effect regions are immutable source regions. Preserve their exact boundaries and white backgrounds. Copy every glyph, punctuation mark, numeral, letter, stroke, spacing, orientation, and line break exactly from the source. Keep text and black ink neutral black. Do not translate, rewrite, regenerate, restyle, move, distort, obscure, or color text.

NO-REFERENCE COLOR POLICY: No external character reference image, named character palette, or Qwen3-VL character analysis is available. Do not invent canonical identity colors. Choose conservative, natural anime colors from the visible grayscale values and surrounding regions. Keep repeated appearances and adjacent parts of the same visible person internally consistent using only the source page. Do not transfer a color from one person to another. Apply outfit colors only to clothing regions already present in the source.

COLOR APPLICATION: Add color beneath existing ink and within existing boundaries. Preserve black outlines, screentones, hatching, texture, contrast, and relative luminance. Color every existing background and object region, including sky and terrain, with varied but restrained hues. Avoid gray wash, monochrome output, muddy colors, single-color casts, gradients, painterly effects, glossy rendering, dramatic relighting, bloom, rim light, and heavy shadows.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENT: Return the same manga page with color added, not a redraw or reconstruction. Except for the necessary addition of color, the result must match the first input image exactly.
